name: Brant Business Interiors
description: Brant Business Interiors is a family-owned Ontario commercial office furniture dealer at 296 George St N, Peterborough — toll-free 1-800-835-9565, quote response within 1 business day. Family-owned since 1964. OECM Supplier Partner under Agreement 2025-470. Part of the Office Central Group of Companies.

mainEntity.name: Are meeting and training tables covered under OECM Agreement 2025-470?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Conference tables, training and folding tables, height-adjustable meeting tables, and collaborative agile tables in this collection are all covered under OECM Agreement 2025-470. Ontario school boards, colleges, hospitals, and municipalities can purchase on an OECM purchase order. Call 1-800-835-9565 or email quotes@brantbusinessinteriors.com referencing the agreement.

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between conference, training, and collaborative tables?

acceptedAnswer.text: Conference tables are sized for scheduled meetings — typical seat counts of 6, 8, 10, or 12, with custom lengths available — and tend to stay fixed in place. Training tables are lighter, foldable or wheeled, and built for rooms that get reconfigured between sessions. Height-adjustable meeting tables suit hybrid teams who want a stand-up huddle option. Collaborative agile tables are mid-height and modular, used in open-plan zones for ad-hoc team work. Tell us the room and the meeting style and we'll recommend a configuration.

mainEntity.name: Can power and data be integrated into the table?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — most conference, meeting, and training tables can be specified with cable grommets and integrated power modules depending on the manufacturer and table series. We itemize the available power options on the quote so your facilities team can confirm electrical access points before the table is installed.

mainEntity.name: Can you quote custom-size conference or training tables?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Stock-size tables ship faster, but custom dimensions, custom edge profiles, and matched veneers are quotable on most series — particularly with Global Furniture Group and Heartwood. Custom builds take longer than stock items. Call 1-800-835-9565 with the dimensions, finish, and seat count and we'll send the quote with a manufacturer-confirmed ship date.
